sizes.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#E5FBFF]
sizes.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#00F5FF]

layouts.hero: Left-aligned, agency-grade composition. Use substantial spacing (py-32). Include trust markers: 'Built on 12 years of IT operations. No login. Instant delivery.'
layouts.tools_grid: Bento-style or strict 2/3 column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-8. py-24. Maximum negative space.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding: p-4, p-8, p-12. Large gaps between sections.

navigation.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#0A0F2C]/95 border-b border-[rgba(0,245,255,0.1)] py-5 px-6 md:px-12 flex justify-between items-center. DO NOT use transparent nav.
navigation.button: Only ONE CTA button in nav, e.g., 'View Toolkit'. Navigates to the tools section. No duplicates.

tool_card.style: Glassmorphism ONLY here. bg-[#0A0F2C]/30 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[rgba(0,245,255,0.15)] rounded-2xl p-8 relative flex flex-col justify-between h-full transition-all duration-300
tool_card.content: Price tag ($29 One-Time) absolutely positioned or right-aligned top. Title and description left-aligned. 'Get Tool' button at bottom. Each card distinct via typography sizing and spacing.
tool_card.button: Plain anchor tags linking to Gumroad URL, target='_blank' rel='noreferrer'. Styled as primary button. No custom cart logic.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F5FF] text-[#0A0F2C] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:bg-[#E5FBFF] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,245,255,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 w-full md:w-auto text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#00F5FF] border border-[#00F5FF] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:bg-[rgba(0,245,255,0.1)] transition-all duration-300

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll enabled at the root app level.
motion.entrance: Framer Motion staggered fade-up (y: 20 -> y: 0) for hero elements and cards. Keep animations elegant and quick.
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards (lift, glow, border opacity) and buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to #E5FBFF and #00F5FF on #0A0F2C to maintain AA/AAA contrast.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for all links and tools. Use semantic HTML (main, section, header, nav, footer).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts; prioritize left-aligned, asymmetrical tension.
STRICT TWO-COLOR RULE: Only use #0A0F2C (Navy base) and #00F5FF (Cyan accent). All other colors, texts, and borders must be opacities or tints of these two.
Ensure glassmorphism is ONLY used on the tool cards, not the nav or hero.
Gumroad links must be simple anchors opening in a new tab. Remove custom cart scripts if any.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers. Ensure nav has a solid or heavily blurred background.
Include 'Built on 12 years of IT operations', 'No login', 'Instant delivery' as trust badges in the hero.

visual_enhancers.textures: Consider a subtle 2-3% noise overlay on the body to remove digital flatness, keeping it premium.
visual_enhancers.background_glow: Subtle, low-opacity (5%) cyan blurred ellipses behind the cards grid to add depth without breaking the duotone constraint.
